fee_schedule.forex_markup_note: 3.50% forex markup is charged on transactions made in currencies other than INR. Applies to international POS payments and online purchases charged in foreign currencyExamples (3.5%):₹100 → ₹3.50₹1,000 → ₹35₹10,000 → ₹350₹1,00,000 → ₹3,500
fee_schedule.atm_withdrawal_note: 2.50% of the withdrawn amount is charged on cash advances using the credit card minimum ₹500, if applicable
fee_schedule.railway_surcharge_note: A surcharge of 1% is applied to transactions made for booking railway tickets
fee_schedule.late_payment_note: An additional ₹100 applies if the Minimum Amount Due is not paid for two consecutive billing cycles

detailed_benefits.details:
• earn 15 Reward Points per ₹100 spent at online and retail Landmark Stores Lifestyle, Home Centre, Max, Spar, Babyshop and EasyBuy
• 10 Reward Points per ₹100 spent on dining, movies and international spends
• The milestone benefit gives 12,000 bonus Reward Points on overall annual retail spends of ₹3,00,000
• Reward Points can also be converted into Landmark Rewards at 2.4 Reward Points = 1 LMR, with 1 LMR = ₹0.60
• Get 6,000 bonus Reward Points worth ₹1,500 on payment of the annual fee
